title: mimulus glabratus subsp. fremontii
intro: Mimulus glabratus subsp. fremontii, commonly known as Fremont's monkey flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phrymaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and stress, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus glabratus subsp. fremontii include its ability to act as an anxiolytic and adaptogenic, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
